title: Spawned sessions carry environment keys that differ only in case, so PowerShell cannot list Env:ENGRAM* or Env:TERMAL*
outcome: A session TermAl spawns on Windows has no two environment variables whose names differ only in case, so PowerShell's environment provider can list them.
acceptance: Spawned sessions carry environment keys that differ only in case, so PowerShell cannot list Env:ENGRAM* or Env:TERMAL* is done
